summary: Iter-18 stabilization: Cloudinary wiring + Admin MVP. Backend contract for Cloudinary endpoints + product/storefront/KYC persistence verified — all 16 backend pytest cases PASS. Admin dashboard at /admin renders all 5 tabs (Overview, Merchants, Stores, Products, Orders) with real data after sign-in. Found two functional bugs to flag: (1) /admin/login route still a placeholder (only the embedded /admin form works), (2) admin Sign-out leaves a malformed double-stringified Zustand envelope in bf_admin_token and does not return user to login screen. Cloudinary 502 with prefix is wired correctly (expected — stale secret).

minor.issue: Returns an envelope {product, similar} — frontend / consumers must un-wrap. Iteration_17 already used this shape; flagging for new test authors.

ui_bugs.issue: Page renders the placeholder 'Admin Login — placeholder / Session D replaces this with real content.' instead of the real login form. The functional login form is embedded inside /admin/page.tsx — anything that programmatically routes to /admin/login lands on a dead page.

Clicking Sign out does NOT redirect back to login and bf_admin_token becomes a malformed double-stringified Zustand envelope: '{"state":{"token":"{\"state\":{\"token\":null},\"version\":0}"},"version":0}' — the inner string was JSON-stringified into the outer envelope. URL remains /admin and the user appears still signed in until reload. Root cause: setting the token store with an already-persist-encoded string.

integration_issues.flow: Merchant cross-route nav after login (Playwright session)
integration_issues.issue: Login as menscape@lokl.demo lands on /merchant/orders OK, but page.goto('/merchant/products') redirects to /merchant/login. Same regression iter_17 documented (refresh_token cookie / Zustand re-hydration race). Not yet fixed.

action_items: Replace /app/frontend/src/app/admin/login/page.tsx placeholder with a real login UI (or remove the route and ensure callers go to /admin).

Fix Admin sign-out: clear the Zustand persist envelope correctly (clearAuth before persist save, and never JSON.stringify a string into state.token). Also router.replace('/admin') AFTER clear so the guard sees no token.

Re-verify the merchant refresh_token cookie collision flagged in iter_17 — still reproducible: deep links to /merchant/products redirect to /merchant/login even immediately after login on /merchant/orders.
Note: Cloudinary 502 with `Image upload failed:` prefix is correctly surfaced (expected today; flagged as external blocker on CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET rotation).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/app/admin/login/page.tsx is an 11-line placeholder shipped to production preview — blocks any router.replace('/admin/login') flows.
Admin token persistence is double-envelope-encoded on sign-out — inspect Zustand store.setState({token: null}) path in the admin auth slice; the value being written is the previous persisted string.
Backend PUT /api/merchant/products/{pid} accepts a raw dict (no Pydantic) — silently accepts unknown fields. Consider a typed Update model so frontend typos don't write garbage.

ProductCreate Pydantic schema field is `image` (singular cover URL) — review_request and the new uploads.ts client helper both speak about `image_url`. Frontend ProductForm must map the upload helper's image_url → body.image, otherwise the cover URL is silently dropped (Pydantic v2 default ignores extras). Verified in tests by sending `image` explicitly.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (admin dashboard all 5 tabs verified; admin/login + sign-out bugs; merchant deep-route nav blocked by known refresh-token race)

Use admin@lokl.in / Admin@2026 directly at /admin — NOT /admin/login (placeholder). Cloudinary 502 with 'Image upload failed:' prefix is EXPECTED until user rotates CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET. For merchant deep-route testing, clear cookies between login sessions in same browser context to avoid the iter_17 refresh_token collision.
rca_of_the_issue: Two iter18-specific bugs: (1) /admin/login was never migrated from placeholder — Phase 5 dashboard rebuild moved the login form INTO /admin/page.tsx but left the legacy route file unupdated. Fix: render the same login UI as /admin or rewrite the placeholder. (2) Admin sign-out double-stringifies the token: after sign-out localStorage shows nested persist envelopes — the cleared state object was JSON-stringified back into the outer envelope's token field. Inspect the admin auth Zustand slice's clearAuth / logout action and ensure it sets state to a fresh object (token:null) rather than re-using the persist-serialised value.
